CHARACTER MOTION
Quaternius — Ultimate Modular Men Pack
https://poly.pizza/bundle/Ultimate-Modular-Men-Pack-ZiH8muWqwQ
CC0 1.0 Universal — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
16 original animation clips retargeted to fitted avatar skeletons and baked at 24 fps.
The Polygonal Mind source avatars were static full-body meshes; the usable 19-joint rigs and skin weights are adaptations for this game. Knight retains its original vertex weighting mapped to the shared bone names.
These adaptations preserve the supplied visible geometry and textures; individual fingers are not separately articulated.

See CREDITS.txt and ADDITIONAL-CREDITS.txt for earlier models and weapons.
Arena music (arena-theme.mp3): original synthesized composition created for Emberfall. Source: scripts/render-music.py. No sampled or third-party music.
